description: ChatGPT 模型路由检测器：查看服务器报告的真实响应模型，自动识别路由降级，GPT Pro 计划降智查询。｜ChatGPT Model Route Inspector: view the actual response model reported by the server, automatically detect routing downgrades, and check whether GPT Pro requests are being downgraded.
